name: Bag of Holding
description: A cloth sack that is larger on the inside than the outside. Its interior dimensions are roughly 2 feet wide and 4 feet deep.

actions.label: Examine
actions.result: The bag appears ordinary from the outside but the interior is clearly much larger than it should be.

actions.label: Pick Up
actions.result: You sling the bag over your shoulder. It's heavier than it looks.
